data.additional_information:
(Company Info)
1.About the company. Vision and Mission
Agile Energy X Inc. was established in 2022 as a wholly-owned subsidiary of Tokyo Electric Power Grid Co., Inc. The company provides innovative solutions that leverage unused renewable energy, such as "distributed computing," to optimize power grids by flexibly creating electricity demand.
Its primary business activities include the development and operation of power-demand facilities, such as container-based Bitcoin mining systems powered by renewable energy. These efforts generate various added values, including environmental and digital benefits, contributing to the promotion of renewable energy adoption. Furthermore, the company is committed to revitalizing local economies and promoting local energy production for local consumption.

(Internship Project)
1.About the project the intern will be participating.
The Agile Energy X Internship Program seeks students who resonate with our mission to build a sustainable energy system by leveraging renewable energy and digital technologies and are eager to actively tackle challenges. Unlike traditional programs with predefined tasks, this program encourages each participant to bring their own ideas and skills to address issues in the energy sector.
Additionally, this program offers a rare opportunity to learn under the guidance of our exceptional CEO, who holds an MBA from Stanford University.
2.What will be the intern doing in this project.
Specifically, interns will work on projects aimed at the flexible utilization of renewable energy and the optimization of distributed energy resources (DER). They will also tackle challenges related to creating digital value through blockchain and cryptocurrency technologies. Through group work, students will explore solutions to these issues and integrate them into real-world projects.
A key feature of this program is its emphasis on leveraging technical curiosity and creativity to develop solutions that account for social impact. Participants will gain valuable experience in contributing to the development of future energy systems while exploring innovative ways to harness renewable energy.
We are looking for students who are genuinely interested in renewable energy and digital technologies, eager to learn proactively, and motivated to collaborate with a team to solve challenges. This internship offers an opportunity not only to deepen technical skills but also to engage in socially significant projects while building practical expertise.
3.What will be the deliverables after completing this internship.
As of now, to be determined (TBD).
